defipunkd.value: Control: tentative orange · Ability to exit: tentative orange · Autonomy: tentative orange · Open Access: tentative green · Verifiability: tentative green
defipunkd.summary: Lido is a liquid staking protocol on Ethereum where users deposit ETH and receive stETH, a rebasing ERC-20 token representing their staked position plus accrued rewards. Deposited ETH is pooled and delegated to a DAO-curated set of professional node operators via the StakingRouter, with validators never having direct custody of user funds. stETH holders can redeem ETH natively through the WithdrawalQueueERC721 or trade on secondary markets. Governance is conducted by LDO token holders via Aragon on-chain voting, with a Dual Governance mechanism allowing stETH holders to veto or delay DAO proposals through an escrow-based signaling system.

details.name: Control
details.description: Short timelock with insider emergency override — Assessed by 4 models — Choosing orange because the DG Emergency Committee (4/7 activation, active until ~July 2026) can collapse DualGovernance, creating an uncontested path of only 5 days (Aragon Voting alone) — below the 7-day green threshold. The normal 9-day path would merit green, and the temporary nature of the Emergency Committee is a meaningful mitigant, but grading on the fast path per the rubric requires acknowledging the sub-7-day route that currently exists. Additionally, the 5% LDO quorum is low by DAO standards. The DG Emergency path is further constrained: it requires 4/7 activation first, then 5/7 execution — a meaningful barrier in practice, but not a hard time-delay in the smart-contract sense.

details.name: Ability to exit
details.description: Finalized claims safe; new requests pausable indefinitely by governance — Assessed by 4 models — Choosing orange because: claims of already-finalized exits are not pause-gated (ruling out red), but two distinct pause vectors remain: (1) the 3/6 GateSeal Committee can unilaterally pause new request placement and finalization for 11 days — above the ≤7-day green threshold — and (2) governance (Lido DAO Aragon vote) can in theory pause indefinitely by assigning PAUSE_ROLE and calling pauseFor(PAUSE_INFINITELY), satisfying the orange condition 'claims-of-finalized are exempt but new-request placement can be paused indefinitely by governance.' Dual Governance and the auto-resume design of PausableUntil are meaningful mitigants but do not bring this to green because the GateSeal itself exceeds the 7-day cap and indefinite DAO governance pause remains theoretically reachable.

details.name: Autonomy
details.description: Oracle committee governs rebase reports — Assessed by 4 models — Choosing orange because the primary unmitigated risk is oracle committee failure (liveness or limited collusion), which cannot cause principal theft under current sanity limits but can materially degrade yield accrual and delay withdrawals over multiple reporting cycles — the ZK second opinion oracle that would close this gap is not yet activated on mainnet (confirmed April 2026 governance forum post). Additionally, wstETH on BNB Chain via Wormhole+Axelar represents a non-canonical bridge trust assumption for a small fraction of TVL. These factors fit Stage 1: external dependency failures are bounded and recoverable (no principal loss) but the full mitigation stack is incomplete. The green steel-man is close — Dual Governance is live, sanity checks are strict, and oracle resilience was demonstrated in practice — but the absent ZK second opinion means the protocol has not yet achieved the 'all critical dependencies have documented active fallbacks' bar for green.

details.name: Open Access
details.description: No user allowlists or geofences — Assessed by 4 models — Choosing green because the evidence supports permissionless contract-level admission for the core user flows and documents independent/direct contract access, while the only verified access restriction is passive ToS language and no A3-active frontend enforcement was observed in the fetched official interface.

details.name: Verifiability
details.description: Verified source + multiple recent audits — Assessed by 4 models — Choosing green because: (1) proxy and implementation contracts are source-verified on Etherscan — the 'Similar Match' on the stETH Aragon AppProxyUpgradeable proxy is explicitly permitted under V1 rules, and all implementation contracts (stETH impl, WithdrawalQueueERC721 impl, wstETH) are independently verified; (2) the public repo lidofinance/core exists and its contract source corresponds to explorer-visible source; (3) the audit portfolio is exceptionally broad and recent — Certora, MixBytes, Consensys Diligence, and Composable Security all completed V3 or ongoing-system audits in Nov-Dec 2025, within the 6-month freshness window. The orange steelman (6-month boundary for V2.1) is weaker because there have been multiple targeted re-audits and deployment validations through mid-2025 for the live contracts, and the green conditions are all satisfied.

details.name: Lido DAO Agent
details.description: governance · Contract — The primary governance executor for the Lido DAO. Holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on most protocol contracts and can upgrade proxies, manage staking modules, configure oracle parameters, and grant/revoke roles across the entire system. Controls $115.42M in direct capital exposure across 17 contracts. All actions flow through the Voting contract, which is gated by the DualGovernance module.

details.name: TokenManager
details.description: Upgradeable — Aragon TokenManager app that manages the LDO governance token. Can mint and destroy LDO tokens, change the token controller, and enable/disable token transfers. Controls $701.56 in direct capital through the LDO token and Voting contract.

details.name: Lido DAO Voting
details.description: Contract — Aragon Voting contract where LDO token holders create and vote on proposals. Can grant, revoke, and manage permissions on the ACL contract, controlling role assignments across the entire DAO infrastructure including the Agent, Finance, and TokenManager apps.

details.name: Executor
details.description: Immutable — Immutable execution contract that forwards governance calls from the EmergencyProtectedTimelock to the Lido DAO Agent and DualGovernance configuration. Can configure governance parameters including submission delays, scheduling delays, and governance state transitions.

details.name: Finance
details.description: Upgradeable — Aragon Finance app that can transfer tokens from the Lido DAO Agent treasury. Gated by ACL permissions managed through the DAO Voting contract.

details.name: Vault score, TVL-weighted
details.description: The mean of pigi’s latest scores of the 4 rated Ethereum vault(s) that deposit into lido-protocol, weighted by their 30-day average TVL ($25.57B in all). Weight in the score: 0.4. Vaults by band: A 1, B 0, C 0, D 1, F 2.

details.name: Weights
details.description: pigi’s fixed formula: score = 0.6 × node rating + 0.4 × vault score. With no rated vault the node rating stands alone.

pigi.note: Headline: lido-protocol. Vault score counts Ethereum vaults only.

text: score = 0.6 × the protocol node's own rating + 0.4 × the TVL-weighted mean (weight = tvl_30d_ma share) of the latest published score of every rated vault that deposits into it; with no rated vault the node rating stands alone (applied.k1 = 1). The band is read straight off the thresholds, without the dwell rule that smooths vault bands, so it can move on any day. A vault that deposits into more than one protocol node (every Morpho vault: the framework and the Blue instance) counts toward each. Vault scores are the published ones — their caps were computed against the node rating as of their own date, so after a node re-rate the two terms agree again at the next nightly. chain_id narrows the vault set only.

findings.title: Aragon Agent (0x3e40D73E) Unverified on Etherscan
findings.description: The Aragon Agent is the on-chain proxy admin for LidoLocator, StakingRouter, WithdrawalQueue, VaultHub, LazyOracle, AccountingOracle proxy, CSModule, Burner, Accounting, and all L1 bridge gateways. Without verified source, privileged execution paths cannot be independently audited, yet this contract can upgrade core protocol logic.

findings.title: AccountingOracle Proxy Unverified
findings.description: AccountingOracle (0x852deD01…) submits consensus reports that drive stETH rebases and withdrawal finalization. Proxy is OssifiableProxy with Agent admin; Etherscan source unavailable for independent audit.

findings.title: Burner Contract Unverified
findings.description: Burner (0xE76c5275…) handles stETH share burning for exited validators and coverage fund flows. Unverified bytecode prevents auditing burn authorization and fund routing logic.

findings.title: Ethereum Beacon Chain Is Foundational Single Point of Failure
findings.description: All staked ETH is deposited via the immutable Ethereum deposit contract and validator rewards/penalties are derived from consensus-layer state. A beacon-chain halt, consensus failure, or prolonged CL data unavailability would freeze rebases, withdrawals, and oracle reporting for the entire pool.

findings.title: LDO Token Contract Unverified
findings.description: LDO governance token (0x5A98FcBE…) is unverified on Etherscan. While not directly custodial, unverified token logic prevents confirming mint/burn/pause controls.

findings.title: Veto Signaling Escrow Unverified
findings.description: Veto Signaling Escrow (0x165813A3…) is part of Dual Governance veto mechanics. Unverified status prevents auditing escrow withdrawal and rage-quit logic.

findings.title: L1 Base Bridge Unverified
findings.description: L1ERC20TokenBridge for Base (0x9de443Ad…) is unverified. Controls wstETH bridging to Base; upgrade path cannot be source-audited.

findings.title: OpStackTokenRatePusher Unverified
findings.description: OpStackTokenRatePusher (0xd54c1c64…) pushes wstETH/stETH exchange rates to L2 bridges. Unverified contract cannot be audited for rate manipulation or unauthorized pushes.

findings.title: Arbitrum Chainlink Rate Feed Unverified
findings.description: Chainlink wstETH/stETH rate feed on Arbitrum (0xB1552C5e…) is unverified. L2 integrations relying on this feed cannot have aggregator logic independently verified.

findings.title: Optimism TokenRateOracle Unverified
findings.description: TokenRateOracle on Optimism (0x294ED1f2…) provides rebasing rate data for bridged stETH. Unverified status blocks audit of rate update authorization.

findings.title: Base L2ERC20TokenBridge Unverified
findings.description: L2ERC20TokenBridge on Base (0xac9D11cD…) handles wstETH deposits/withdrawals on L2. Unverified bytecode prevents auditing mint/burn and admin upgrade paths.

findings.title: Polygon DataBus Unverified
